div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Queue depth or backlog age
trending up for 2+ weeks

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Decompose the increase:
concentrated in 1-3 rules,
or broad-based?

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Post-triage false-positive
rate on those rules?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Detection-quality problem.
See DEH Part 42 and Part 38
before adding headcount.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Likely genuine new threat
volume or a coverage gain --
confirm with detection
engineering, then size the
added load with Part 5.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Arrival rate rising,
or clearance rate falling
with arrival flat?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Traces to a known change --
onboarding, M&A, new asset
class, new business unit?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Unexplained volume growth --
treat as hunt-worthy, not
just a staffing input.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Tied to headcount loss,
attrition, or a tenure/
skill-mix shift?

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Staffing/skill problem.
See Part 16 and Part 18.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Process friction -- check
shift balance (Sec.4) and tier
hand-off criteria (Part 3).
